correctness.rationale: An explicit 11-word code has pairwise disjoint one-deletion shadows. The Kim-Lee-Oh normalized count gives \(|C|\le 12\) at \(q=3\); equality would force \(|C_{4,2}|=3\). There are exactly two orientations for each repeated outer symbol and all eight triples have a deletion collision, so 12 is impossible. The bundled standard-library verifier independently solves the complete 81-vertex compatibility graph and returns optimum 11.
